content: Unlike in 1999 and 2014, LGBTQ terms in the year 1993 seem to be associated with higher-valence words, especially homosexual, whose nearby words had the highest average valence in 1993 out of all years. Homosexual's unique nearest neighbors in 1993 include the high-valence words morale, pledge, civilian, compromise, force, and readiness. This words appear to be connected with numerous stories in 1993 covering the controversy over whether or not LGBTQ people should be allowed to serve in the military.
